premise: A technically valid Physics learner unit must bind setup, representation, governing relation, working, result and verification. Mere presence of a diagram/equation is insufficient.

component_semantics.PHYSICAL_SETUP: Objects/event, givens, unknown, reference frame, axes/sign convention when material.
component_semantics.TECHNICAL_REPRESENTATION: A Physics-domain representation carrying structure needed to understand or solve the task.
component_semantics.GOVERNING_RELATION: Law, equation, vector relation, geometric relation or model condition selected for the task.
component_semantics.MAPPING_OR_WORKING: Visible bridge from representation/givens into the governing relation, including intermediate transformation/algebra when material.
component_semantics.RESULT_OR_CONCLUSION: Numerical, symbolic or conceptual result stated in the requested frame/quantity.
component_semantics.VERIFICATION: At least one material sign, direction, units, dimensional, limiting-case, physical-sense or model-validity check.
